(gemifloxacin) Adverse Effects and Precautions As for Ciprofloxacin, p.244. Skin rashes may be more common with gemifloxacin and treat- ment should be stopped if they occur. Interactions As for Ciprofloxacin, p.246. Antimicrobial Action As for Ciprofloxacin, p.246. Gemifloxacin is reported to have greater activity against Gram- positive bacteria, including pneumococci, than ciprofloxacin. ◊ References. 1. Morrissey I, Tillotson G. Activity of gemifloxacin against Strep- tococcus pneumoniae and Haemophilus influenzae. J Antimicrob Chemother 2004; 53: 144–8. Pharmacokinetics Gemifloxacin is rapidly absorbed from the gastrointestinal tract with an absolute bioavailability of about 71%. Peak plasma con- centrations occur 0.5 to 2 hours after an oral dose.
